description: This file defines the PayGradeService class, which provides business logic for managing pay grades, currencies, and related data in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting pay grade data, as well as validating salary amounts against currency constraints.

classes.name: PayGradeService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to handle pay grade related operations such as retrieval, validation, addition, and deletion within the HRM system.

methods.name: getPayGradeDao
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setPayGradeDao
methods.description: Sets the PayGradeDao instance for the service.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Fetches a specific PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Returns a list of pay grades, optionally filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currencies associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Returns a list of PayGradeCurrency entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PayGradeCurrency records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a PayGradeCurrency record based on currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: isValidSalaryAmountForPayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Validates whether a salary amount is within the min and max salary bounds for a given currency and pay grade.

methods.name: getPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes an array of pay periods.

methods.name: getPayGradeArray
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes an array of pay grades.

methods.name: getCurrencyArray
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes an array of currencies.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Fetches a currency entity by its ID.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Saves a new or existing pay grade entity.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Saves a new or existing PayGradeCurrency entity.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple pay grades based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed pay currencies based on filter parameters.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes specified pay grade currencies by their IDs for a given pay grade.
